case.summary: OpenShift SDN pod-to-pod networking failure after cluster upgrade to 4.16 — CrowdStrike Falcon sensor DaemonSet unable to reach API server
case.description:
After upgrading our production OpenShift cluster from 4.15 to 4.16, pod-to-pod networking is intermittently failing across worker nodes. The CrowdStrike Falcon sensor DaemonSet pods cannot reach the Kubernetes API server, causing our endpoint detection agent to lose visibility on approximately 40% of nodes.

Symptoms:
- Falcon sensor pods on affected nodes log: 'connection refused: api.cwpp-openshift-01.crowdstrike.internal:6443'
- OVN-Kubernetes pods show restart loops on 3 of 8 worker nodes
- NetworkPolicy objects are not being enforced consistently
- The issue started within 2 hours of completing the cluster upgrade

Environment:
- OpenShift 4.16.2 (upgraded from 4.15.18)
- OVN-Kubernetes network plugin
- 3 control plane + 8 worker nodes on bare metal
- CrowdStrike Falcon Operator v1.3.0 deployed via OLM

Business impact: Our security operations center has reduced visibility into container workloads. This is a P1 for our security team as it affects our ability to detect threats in the containerized environment.

We need guidance on:
1. Whether this is a known regression in OVN-Kubernetes for 4.16
2. Steps to restore network connectivity without a full rollback
3. Whether the Falcon DaemonSet needs updated network policies for 4.16
